characters.summary: Geralt is a genetically enhanced monster hunter who combines swordsmanship, mutagens, alchemical potions, and minor magical signs to dispatch foes.

mechanisms: Parrying and dodging with superhuman reflexes

weaknesses: Vulnerable to heavy physical trauma if shields fail
Requires preparation and meditation to use most advanced alchemical brews effectively
limitations: Stamina limits the continuous use of Witcher signs without rest
Toxic load restricts the number of alchemical potions that can be consumed at once

sources.supports: Basic summary of Geralt's combat style, mutations, and signs.

feats.claim: Defeated multiple formidable monsters and higher vampires using swords and signs.

notableResults.citation: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt storyline climax
notableResults.note: Defeated the King of the Wild Hunt in single combat.

campaignTags.claim: Uses Witcher Signs such as Igni, Aard, and Quen in combat.

unknowns: Exact limits of mutant endurance against overwhelming cosmic forces are not fully quantified.

characters.summary: Guile is a United States Air Force major who utilizes disciplined martial arts combined with projectile sonic booms and flash kick anti-air maneuvers.
weaknesses: Charge-based fighting style requires brief setup time for special moves
Vulnerable if caught off-guard from behind while holding a defensive charge
limitations: Must briefly charge backward or downward before executing Sonic Booms and Flash Kicks

sources.supports: Guile's background as an Air Force major and signature moves like Sonic Boom and Flash Kick.

feats.claim: Fought and defeated high-level martial artists and operatives in the World Warrior tournaments.

unknowns: Exact upper velocity limits of his Sonic Booms.

characters.summary: Illidan Stormrage is a night elf demon hunter wielding twin warglaives, green fel magic, and spectral sight, combining unmatched agility with chaotic demonic energy.
weaknesses: Blind physically (relies entirely on spectral/magical sight)
Susceptible to corruption and magical displacement
limitations: Fel magic usage places strain on mortal physical limits

sources.supports: Illidan's background as a demon hunter, warglaives, and fel powers.

feats.claim: Fought against armies of the Burning Legion and rival leaders.

notableResults.citation: The Nighthold raid cinematic, World of Warcraft: Legion

conditional.ability: Full demon form transformation (Metamorphosis) with massively increased physical power

campaignTags.claim: Wields fel magic and arcane energy.
Possesses large demon wings allowing natural flight.

unknowns: Exact limits of his immortality tied to the Twisting Nether.

characters.summary: In his Metamorphosis form, Illidan transforms into a towering demon, vastly amplifying his physical strength, durability, and offensive fel output.
weaknesses: Larger target for ranged attacks and artillery
Time-limited form depending on available demonic energy
characters.formDifferences: Transforms from a night elf demon hunter into a massive winged demon, greatly increasing physical mass, melee damage output, and durability while relying on fel energy.

sources.supports: Details on Illidan's Metamorphosis demon form and abilities.

unknowns: Exact duration limit of the Metamorphosis transformation in open combat.

characters.summary: Isabelle is a helpful Shih Tzu secretary who uses cheerful diplomacy, administrative tools, party poppers, and occasionally unexpected assistive items in battle contexts.

mechanisms: Evade and dodge with cheerful agility

weaknesses: Lacks supernatural or military combat training
Physically fragile compared to dedicated fighters
mobility: Using a recovery balloon or vine in crossover settings
limitations: Relies on comedic or mundane items for offense

sources.supports: Overview of Isabelle as a character in Animal Crossing and Super Smash Bros.

feats.claim: Competed against seasoned video game fighters using everyday tools and party items.

notableResults.note: Standard tournament matches against fellow villagers.

unknowns: True combat effectiveness outside of stylized crossover fighting games.

characters.summary: Jigglypuff is a balloon-like Pokémon that lulls opponents to sleep with soothing lullabies before delivering devastating point-blank Rest attacks.
weaknesses: Extremely lightweight and easily knocked away by powerful attacks
Vulnerable if 'Rest' misses or fails to defeat the target
limitations: Sleeps briefly after using the Rest move, leaving it vulnerable

sources.supports: Jigglypuff characteristics, Sing ability, and inflatable nature.

feats.claim: Knocked out heavy opponents using the Rest technique after putting them to sleep.

campaignTags.claim: Floats through the air like a balloon.

unknowns: Exact lung capacity for continuous singing.

characters.summary: Jill Valentine is a former S.T.A.R.S. operative and expert survivor who utilizes firearms, tactical explosives, evasion maneuvers, and combat knife proficiency against bioweapons.

mechanisms: First aid sprays and healing herbs

weaknesses: Human biological vulnerability to T-Virus and heavy physical trauma
limitations: Relies entirely on standard firearms and military equipment

sources.supports: Jill Valentine background as a S.T.A.R.S. member and survivor of Raccoon City.

feats.claim: Survived the destruction of Raccoon City and defeated mutated bioweapons like Nemesis.

notableResults.note: Defeated Nemesis using a railgun after prolonged encounters.

campaignTags.claim: Carries lockpicks, tactical gear, and explosives.

unknowns: Long-term antibody resistance levels after repeated bioweapon exposure.
